summaryForCoordinator: CONSENT. 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, 1 non-blocking advisory. The subject is unmoved at cff61a53… mode 0444, re-verified at the end of review. All 11 hex tokens in the draft were independently recomputed and all 11 match, including the two short tokens resolved against frozen v3's own bytes rather than taken on the draft's word. v4 and both Stage A verdicts are mode 0444 and independently confirm ACCEPT 0/0; the Claude advisory CLAUDE-G07-V4-ADV-1 is carried and Codex's zero-advisory count is stated correctly. The non-unwrite span parses to exactly 43 members, 167 through 209, with D-168 present. Every scope-widening move on the attack list is negated in the draft's own bytes and refuted against live state: no SATISFIED, no Class A, no QUALIFIED, no DR-103 or DR-117 satisfaction, no DR-G* row, required-now still 28, file 08 and COORD both byte-identical to their cited digests and clean in git, and no authorization of docs/v2/implementation/. As a gate row it explicitly declines to claim that D-056 gates 2 and 3 do not hold. Structure matches the adopted D-209 precedent with the correct G07-specific additions and a correctly incremented no-cell-edit bound.
